retrievalProfile.description: Produces a vintage 1960s psychedelic layout featuring an arched frame containing a group portrait and cityscape silhouette topped with a rainbow border and curved display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central arched window containing a multi-layered composition: a group of stylized human figures in the mid-ground, a bridge silhouette in the background, and a cityscape silhouette in the foreground. The arch is defined by a multi-colored rainbow stroke and topped with text that follows the curve of the arch.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric rainbow bands framing the central illustration
Text following the outer curvature of the arch
High-contrast, flat-color portraiture overlapping a monochromatic cityscape
A solid circular sun element positioned off-center within the arch
coreInvariants: The arch shape as the primary container
Muted cream or off-white background outside the arch
Flat, graphic illustration style with high-contrast facial features

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of people occupies the center of the arch, scaled to fill the middle third vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The arched rainbow border acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the text at the top, moves down through the rainbow bands into the central figures, and finally to the cityscape at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant cream-colored negative space surrounds the arch on the top and sides.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal-blue for the cityscape and figure shadows
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream for the exterior background and highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the sun and pink/orange/green for rainbow bands
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, vintage saturation levels with high value contrast in the portraits.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a screen-printed aesthetic palette

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are rotated individually to follow a precise circular arc

composition.position: arched over the top of the central frame
composition.relationshipToImage: follows the outer boundary of the rainbow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all display elements to maintain 1960s graphic purity.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric circularity for the arched layout.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vintage screen-print style illustration of a group of people in front of a bridge, with a cityscape silhouette in the foreground, all contained within a multi-colored rainbow arch on a cream background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text following the curve of the arch in black, with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text following the curve of the arch?
Is the cityscape a flat silhouette overlaying the figures?
Is the background a muted cream color?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the people
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible and follows the arc perfectly.
Check that the rainbow colors do not bleed into the cream background.
Verify the high-contrast 'posterized' look of the portraits.
Confirm the cityscape silhouette is in the bottom foreground layer.
recipe.reuseFormula: Arched frame + concentric rainbow + radial geometric sans text + flat pop-art illustration.
